name: Climb Wall For VIP Obby
desc:
Welcome to Climb Wall For VIP Obby, in this obby you have to climb a giant wall with a tool that places rocks for players to climb to the top!

At the end of this Obby/Parkour Game, you will have access to the "VIP" which is nothing more than an area with several tools, luckyblock, skins and morphs totally free for you..

PREMIUM BENEFITS:
- Premium Chat Tag
- Premium Icon above head
- Half wait on Rare Purple Luckyblock


👍 Thumbs up if you enjoyed the game!
⭐ Favorite if you really enjoyed the game!
🎉 Finish for a special surprise! 🎉
